# Vendored engine

`swarm.js` is the build engine from https://github.com/DhvanilPatel/swarm-cursors,
vendored unmodified to run the 1:1 build inside this site.

The upstream repo has **no license** and adapts work from Joel Califa's Swarm
(https://github.com/califa/swarm-site, also unlicensed). Do not publish or
redistribute this build without permission from both authors.

Integration changes live in `site/xenith.js` (`loadSwarmEngine`), not in this file.
